note: bamboo_twig_cacheable (submodule of bamboo_twig) registers one Twig function bamboo_attach_cacheable_metadata(cacheable_metadata) on service bamboo_twig_cacheable.twig.bubble_metadata. It returns a render array ['#cache' => array_intersect_key($input, {tags,contexts,max-age})] — keeping only tags/contexts/max-age and dropping other keys. Medium cases are live-registration/behaviour introspection. Hard cases have the agent write a Twig template (under web/sites/default/files/) that calls the function; the verify renders it inside a RenderContext and asserts the cache tag/context actually bubbled.

evals.prompt: What does bamboo_twig_cacheable's Twig function do, and which cache metadata keys does it keep from the array you pass it?
evals.expected_output: bamboo_attach_cacheable_metadata(metadata) attaches render-array #cache metadata so it bubbles to the response, keeping only the 'tags', 'contexts' and 'max-age' keys (other keys are dropped).

evals.prompt: Show how to call bamboo_attach_cacheable_metadata from a Twig template to add a cache tag and a cache context.
evals.expected_output: Pass a Twig hash, e.g. {{ bamboo_attach_cacheable_metadata({'tags': ['node:1'], 'contexts': ['user.permissions']}) }}.

evals.prompt: How do I make a template fragment uncacheable using bamboo_twig_cacheable?
On this live Drupal site, inspect the enabled bamboo_twig_cacheable submodule and give the exact name of the Twig function it registers.
evals.expected_output: It registers the Twig function bamboo_attach_cacheable_metadata (service bamboo_twig_cacheable.twig.bubble_metadata).

evals.prompt: On this live site, if you pass bamboo_attach_cacheable_metadata an array that also contains an unrecognized key like 'foo', what happens to that key? Verify by inspecting the module's behaviour.
evals.expected_output: Unknown keys such as 'foo' are dropped — the function keeps only tags, contexts and max-age via array_intersect_key.

evals.prompt: Using bamboo_twig_cacheable, create a Twig template at web/sites/default/files/bamboo_twig_cacheable_attach_tag.html.twig that attaches the cache tag 'node:99' to the response.
evals.expected_output: Write {{ bamboo_attach_cacheable_metadata({'tags': ['node:99']}) }}; when rendered in a render context the cache tag node:99 bubbles up.

evals.prompt: Using bamboo_twig_cacheable, create a Twig template at web/sites/default/files/bamboo_twig_cacheable_attach_context.html.twig that declares the fragment varies by the 'user.permissions' cache context.
evals.expected_output: Write {{ bamboo_attach_cacheable_metadata({'contexts': ['user.permissions']}) }}; rendering bubbles the user.permissions cache context.
